evidence.detail: Grid.sort() overrides DataManager.sort() only to change the default sortOrder from 'ASC' to 'AUTO'
DataManager.sort() uses sortOrder='ASC' as default; Grid overrides this because the metagame API already handles AUTO
archetype_order_by() already resolves 'AUTO' to the per-field default_order; other *_order_by() functions do not (they assert ASC|DESC only)

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/data/clauses.py, add AUTO resolution to decks_order_by(), cards_order_by(), people_order_by(), head_to_head_order_by(), leaderboard_order_by(), matches_order_by(), and rotation_order_by() following the same pattern as archetype_order_by() (lines 183-194): define a sort_options dict with (col, default_order), resolve AUTO before the assert. In shared_web/static/js/datamanager.jsx change sort() default to 'AUTO'. Then remove the overriding sort() method from shared_web/static/js/grid.jsx.
triage.notes: Pattern already proven in archetype_order_by(). Each sort field needs its natural default direction defined, which is straightforward from the existing sort_options dicts.
